Name: Axebot
Pattern: Chooses randomly from One-Two, Sharpen, and Hammer Uppercut (allowed options equally likely). Cannot Sharpen twice in a row. Cannot use One-Two or Hammer Uppercut more than twice in a row. Summoned Axebots (from Stock) immediately start with Boot Up, then resume choosing random moves.

Name: Bowlbug (Egg)
Pattern: Always uses Bite.

Name: Bowlbug (Nectar)
Pattern: Starts with Thrash -> Buff. Then uses Thrash every turn.

Name: Bowlbug (Rock)
Pattern: Uses Headbutt every turn. If fully blocked, becomes stunned for a turn before resuming Headbutt.

Name: Bowlbug (Silk)
Pattern: Alternates between Toxic Spit and Thrash.

Name: Calcified Cultist
Pattern: Starts with Incantation. Then uses Dark Strike every turn after.

Name: Chomper
Pattern: First Chomper starts with Clamp, second with Screech. Then continue cycling through Clamp -> Screech.

Name: Corpse Slug
Pattern: First Corpse Slug picks its first move randomly. Each subsequent Corpse Slug starts with the next move in the cycle. Cycle through Whip Slap  -> Glomp -> Gloop

Name: Cubex Construct
Pattern: Cycles through Charge Up -> Repeater Blast - > Repeater Blast -> Expel Blast -> Submerge.

Name: Damp Cultist
Pattern: Starts with Incantation. Then uses Dark Strike every turn after.

Name: Devoted Sculptor
Pattern: Starts with Forbidden Incantation, then uses Savage every turn.

Name: Exoskeleton
Pattern: First Exoskeleton starts with Skitter, second starts with Mandible, third starts with Enrage (and fourth starts randomly with Skitter or Mandible, if present). After Skitter always uses Mandible. After Mandible always uses Enrage. After Enrage chooses randomly between Skitter and Mandible.

Name: Fabricator
Pattern: When # allies (not counting self) is 2 or fewer, picks randomly between Fabricate and Fabricating Strike (equally likely). When # allies (not counting self) is 3 or more, always uses Disintegrate.

Name: Guardbot
Pattern: Always uses Guard

Name: Noisebot
Pattern: Always uses Noise

Name: Stabbot
Pattern: Always uses Stab

Name: Zapbot
Pattern: Always uses Zap

Name: Flyconid
Pattern: Starts randomly with Frail Spores or Smash (equal probability). Then picks move randomly (equal probability for allowed moves). Cannot use any move twice in a row. Vulnerable Spores has a 3 turn cooldown after use, and Frail Spores has a 2 turn cooldown after use. Exception: If at any point it uses Vuln Spores -> Frail Spores -> Smash, then it will have no allowed moves and default to Vulnerable Spores.

Name: Fogmog
Pattern: Starts with Illusion -> Swipe. When using Swipe after a non-Swipe move, follows up with 40% chance to Swipe and 60% chance to Headbutt. After using Swipe for second time in a row, always follows with Headbutt. After Headbutt, always uses Swipe.

Name: Eye with Teeth
Pattern: Always uses Distract.

Name: Fossil Stalker
Pattern: Starts with Latch. Then chooses randomly between allowed options of Tackle, Latch, and Lash (allowed options equally likely). Moves cannot be used more than twice in a row.

Name: Frog Knight
Pattern: Cycles through Tongue Lash -> Strike Down Evil -> For the Queen. After For the Queen, if below half HP and Beetle Charge has not been used, then uses Beetle Charge before starting the cycle over.

Name: Fuzzy Wurm Crawler
Pattern: Starts with Acid Goop. Then cycles through Inhale -> Acid Goop -> Acid Goop.

Name: Globe Head
Pattern: Cycles through Shocking Slap -> Thunder Strike -> Galvanic Burst.

Name: Gremlin Merc
Pattern: Cycles through Gimme -> Double Smash -> Hehe.
Notes: Stolen gold is held by Fat Gremlin once summoned

Name: Fat Gremlin
Pattern: Always uses Flee.
Notes: Starts stunned when summoned after killing Gremlin Merc. Keeps stolen gold if successfully Flees.

Name: Sneaky Gremlin
Pattern: Always uses Tackle.
Notes: Starts stunned when summoned after killing Gremlin Merc.

Name: Haunted Ship
Pattern: Starts with Ramming Speed -> Haunt. Then picks randomly between Ramming Speed, Swipe, and Stomp (allowed options equally likely). Cannot use same move twice in a row.

Name: Hunter Killer
Pattern: Starts with Tenderizing Goop. Then chooses randomly between Bite and Puncture each turn. Bite cannot be used twice in a row. Puncture cannot be used more than twice in a row.

Name: Inklet
Pattern: Front and back Inklet start with Jab. Middle Inklet starts with Whirlwind. Alternates between Jab -> Whirlwind or Piercing Gaze (chosen randomly, equally likely).

Name: Leaf Slime (Small)
Pattern: Starts randomly with Tackle or Goop. Then alternates between them.

Name: Leaf Slime (Medium)
Pattern: Starts with Sticky Shot then alternates Clump Shot -> Sticky Shot.

Name: Living Fog
Pattern: Starts with Advanced Gas. Then alternates between Bloat -> Super Gas Blast.

Name: Gas Bomb
Pattern: Uses Explode and dies.

Name: Living Shield
Pattern: Uses Shield Slam every turn if Turret Operator is alive. Then uses Smash every turn once Turret Operator is dead.

Name: Louse Progenitor
Pattern: Cycles through Web Cannon -> Curl and Grow -> Pounce.

Name: Mawler
Pattern: Starts with Claw. Then chooses randomly between Rip & Tear, Roar, and Claw (all allowed options equally likely). Roar can only be used once. Claw and Rip & Tear cannot be used twice in a row.

Name: Myte
Pattern: First Myte starts with Toxic, second Myte starts with Suck. Then continue cycling through Toxic -> Bite -> Suck.
Notes: Toxic (status): At the end of your turn, take 5 damage if this is in your hand. 1 cost, exhausts.

Name: Nibbit
Pattern: In the single Nibbit encounter, it cycles through Butt -> Slice -> Hiss. In the two Nibbits encounter, the front starts with Slice and the back starts with Hiss. They then continue the cycle Butt -> Slice -> Hiss.

Name: Ovicopter
Pattern: Starts with Lay Eggs -> Smash -> Tenderizer. If 3 allies are alive after Tenderizer, uses Nutritional Paste -> Smash -> Tenderizer. If less than 3 allies are alive after Tenderizer, uses Lay Eggs -> Smash -> Tenderizer.
Notes: Lay Eggs will summon until there are 3 allies alive (no allies alive -> summons 3, 1 allies alive -> summons 2, etc)

Name: Tough Egg
Pattern: Always uses Hatch.

Name: Hatchling
Pattern: Always uses Nibble.

Name: Owl Magistrate
Pattern: Cycles through Magistrate Scrutiny -> Peck Assault -> Judicial Flight -> Verdict.

Name: Punch Construct
Pattern: Regular encounter: Cycles through Ready -> Strong Punch -> Fast Punch. Punch-Off event: First Punch Construct starts the cycle with Strong Punch (second starts with Ready like usual).

Name: Ruby Raider (Assassin)
Pattern: Always uses Killshot.

Name: Ruby Raider (Axe)
Pattern: Cycles through Swing -> Swing -> Big Swing.

Name: Ruby Raider (Brute)
Pattern: Alternates between Beat -> Roar.

Name: Ruby Raider (Crossbow)
Pattern: Alternates between Reload -> Fire.

Name: Ruby Raider (Tracker)
Pattern: Starts with Track, then uses Hounds every turn.

Name: Scroll of Biting
Pattern: First scroll picks its first move randomly. Scrolls 2 and 3 starts with the next moves in the cycle Chomp -> Chew -> More Teeth. Scroll 4 (if present) starts with More Teeth. Then follows pattern Chomp -> More Teeth -> Chew, but after Chew picks randomly between Chomp and More Teeth and resumes pattern.

Name: Seapunk
Pattern: Cycles through Sea Kick -> Spinning Kick -> Bubble Burp.

Name: Sewer Clam
Pattern: Alternates between Pressurize -> Jet.

Name: Shrinker Beetle
Pattern: Starts with Shrinker. Then alternates Chomp -> Stomp.

Name: Slimed Berserker
Pattern: Cycles through Vomit Ichor -> Furious Pummeling -> Leeching Hug -> Smother.

Name: Slithering Strangler
Pattern: Alternates between Constrict -> Thwack/Lash (chooses between Thwack and Lash at random, equally likely)

Name: Sludge Spinner
Pattern: Starts with Oil Spray. Then chooses randomly between all allowed moves each turn. Cannot use any move twice in a row.

Name: Slumbering Beetle
Pattern: Sleeps until it awakens. Then uses Roll Out every turn.

Name: Snapping Jaxfruit
Pattern: Always uses Energy Orb.

Name: Spiny Toad
Pattern: Cycles through Protruding Spikes -> Spike Explosion -> Tongue Lash.

Name: The Lost
Pattern: Alternates between Debilitating Smog -> Eye Lasers

Name: The Forgotten
Pattern: Alternates between Miasma -> Dread.

Name: The Obscura
Pattern: Starts with Illusion. Then chooses randomly between Piercing Gaze, Wail, and Hardening Strike (allowed options equally likely). Cannot use any move twice in a row.

Name: Parafright
Pattern: Always uses Slam.

Name: Thieving Hopper
Pattern: Always uses Thievery -> Flutter -> Hat Trick -> Nab -> Escape. If stunned before turn 5, resumes with the next intent in the pattern. If stunned on turn 5, tries to Escape again.

Name: Toadpole
Pattern: Front Toadpole starts with Spiken. Non-front Toadpole(s) start with Whirl. Then continue following cycle Spike Spit -> Whirl -> Spiken (then repeat).

Name: Tunneler
Pattern: Starts with Bite -> Burrow. While Burrowed, always uses Below. After being stunned, loses Burrowed and uses Bite -> Burrow.

Name: Turret Operator
Pattern: Cycles through Unload -> Unload -> Reload.

Name: Twig Slime (Small)
Pattern: Uses Tackle every turn.

Name: Twig Slime (Medium)
Pattern: Starts with Sticky Shot -> Clump Shot. Then chooses randomly each turn between Sticky Shot and Clump Shot (allowed options equally likely). Cannot use Sticky Shot twice in a row, and cannot use Clump shot more than twice in a row.

Name: Two-Tailed Rat
Pattern: First Rat starts randomly with Scratch, Disesase Bite, or Screech. 2nd Rat has next move after it in the cycle Scratch -> Disease Bite -> Screech, and 3rd Rat has the next after that. A rat cannot Call for Backup until it has taken 2 turns. Each rat can only Call for Backup once. Only 1 rat can Call for Backup in any particular turn. Call for Backup can only be used 3 times total across all rats. If Call for Backup is not allowed for a rat, it picks randomly between Scratch, Disease Bite, and Screech (equal weight among allowed options). If Call for Backup is allowed for a rat, then it has a 75% chance to Call for Backup, and remaining 25% to pick randomly between Scratch, Disease Bite, and Screech (equal weight among allowed options). Screech has a 3 turn cooldown. Scratch and Disease Bite cannot be used twice in a row.

Name: Vine Shambler
Pattern: Cycles through Swipe -> Grasping Vines -> Chomp.

Name: Wriggler
Pattern: If spawned from Phrog Parasite's death, starts stunned. Otherwise (or after stun), Wrigglers in positions 1 & 3 start with Nasty Bite and Wrigglers in positions 2 & 4 start with Wriggle. They then alternate between Nasty Bite -> Wriggle.

Name: Bygone Effigy
Pattern: Starts with Sleep -> Wake -> Slash. Then uses Slash every turn after.

Name: Byrdonis
Pattern: Alternates between Swoop -> Peck.

Name: Decimillipede
Pattern: First segment starts with a random move, second segment starts with the next move in the cycle Writhe -> Bulk -> Constrict, and third segment starts with the next move after that.

Name: (3 segments)
HP: (always even #, segments have different max HP)
Pattern: Cycles through Writhe -> Constrict -> Bulk. When killed, spends one turn dead and then one turn reviving with 25 HP. After reviving, continues the regular attack cycle from a random starting move.

Name: Entomancer
Pattern: Cycles through Bees -> Spear -> Pheromone Spit. After reaching 3 stacks of Personal Hive, switches to gaining 2 strength when using Pheromone Spit.

Name: Infested Prism
Pattern: Cycles through Jab -> Radiate -> Whirlwind -> Pulsate

Name: Flail Knight
Pattern: Starts with Ram. Then chooses randomly between War Chant, Flail, and Ram (allowed options equally likely). Flail and Ram cannot be used more than twice in a row. War Chant cannot be used twice in a row.

Name: Spectral Knight
Pattern: Starts with Hex and then Soul Slash. Then chooses randomly between Soul Slash and Soul Flame (allowed options equally likely). Soul Slash cannot be used more than twice in a row. Soul Flame cannot be used twice in a row.

Name: Magi Knight
Pattern: Cycles through Power Shield -> Dampen -> Spear -> Prep -> Magic Bomb.

Name: Mecha Knight
Pattern: Starts with Charge. Then cycles through Flamethrower -> Windup -> Heavy Cleave.

Name: Phantasmal Gardener
Pattern: 1st one starts with Flail, 2nd with Bite, 3rd with Lash, and 4th with Enlarge. Then cycle through Bite -> Lash -> Flail -> Enlarge.

Name: Phrog Parasite
Pattern: Alternates between Infect -> Lash.

Name: Skulking Colony
Pattern: Cycles through Smash -> Zoom -> Inertia -> Super Crab.

Name: Soul Nexus
Pattern: Starts with Soul Burn. Then picks randomly between Soul Burn, Maelstrom, and Drain Life (all allowed options equally likely). Cannot use the same move twice in a row.

Name: Terror Eel
Pattern: Cycles between Crash -> Thrash until it gets stunned by reaching 75 HP. Then uses Terror before cycling Crash -> Thrash again.

Name: Ceremonial Beast
Pattern: Starts with Stamp. Then uses Plow every turn until it is stunned. After being stunned, cycles through Beast Cry -> Stomp -> Crush.

Name: Door
Pattern:
Cycles through Dramatic Open -> Door Slam -> Enforce.

On death, becomes Doormaker.
StartsWith: 3*N (4*N) {strength} and 20*N (25*N) extra max HP (N = times Door has been summoned; starts at 0)

Name: Doormaker
Pattern: "Starts stunned on the turn it's phased
Notes: then does Beam -> Get Back In."

Name: Crusher
Pattern: Cycles through Thrash -> Enlarging Strike -> Bug Sting -> Adapt -> Guarded Strike.

Name: Rocket
Pattern: Cycles through Targeting Reticle -> Precision Beam -> Charge Up -> Laser -> Recharge.

Name: Knowledge Demon
Pattern: Cycles through Curse of Knowledge -> Slap -> Knowledge Overwhelming -> Ponder until Curse of Knowledge has been used 3 times. Then cycles through Slap -> Knowledge Overwhelming -> Ponder.
Notes: * Heal is multiplied by player count

Name: Lagavulin Matriarch
Pattern: Cycles through Slash -> Disembowel -> Slash 2 -> Soul Siphon.
Notes: On wakeup, all Plating is removed.

Name: Queen
Pattern:
Begins with Puppet Strings -> You Are Mine!

Afterwards, while Amalgam is alive, always does Burn Bright For Me. If Amalgam dies and intent is Burn Bright For Me, intent is immediately replaced with Enrage.

After Amalgam dies, cycles Off With Your Head -> Execution -> Enrage.
Notes: If Amalgam dies and intent is Burn Bright For Me, Enrage instead.
StartsWith: a Torch Head Amalgam in play

Name: Torch Head Amalgam
Pattern:
Begins with Tackle -> Tackle.

Afterwards, cycles Soul Beam -> Weak Tackle -> Weak Tackle.

Name: Soul Fysh
Pattern: Cycles through Beckon -> De-Gas -> Gaze -> Fade -> Scream.
Notes: Beckon: 1 cost status, lose 6 HP if it is in hand at the end of turn. * One of the 2 Intangible from Fade ticks down immediately.

Name: Test Subject Stage 1
Pattern:
Cycles through Bite -> Skull Bash.

When killed, revive next turn in stage 2.

Name: Test Subject Stage 2
Pattern:
Cycles through Multi-Claw -> Pounce.

When killed, revive next turn in stage 3.

Name: Test Subject Stage 3
Pattern: Cycles through Lacerate -> Big Pounce -> Burning Growl.

Name: The Insatiable
Pattern:
Starts with Liquify Ground.

Afterwards, cycles through Thrash -> Lunging Bite -> Salivate -> Thrash.
Notes: Frantic Escape: 1 cost status, increase card cost and Sandpit by 1.

Name: Kin Priest
Pattern: Cycles through Orb of Frailty -> Orb of Weakness -> Beam -> Ritual.

Name: Kin Follower
Pattern: Cycles through Quick Slash -> Boomerang -> Power Dance.

Name: Vantom
Pattern: Cycles through Ink Blot -> Inky Lance -> Dismember -> Prepare.

Name: Waterfall Giant
Pattern: Cycles through Pressurize -> Stomp -> Ram -> Siphon -> Pressure Gun -> Pressure Up.
Notes: * Heal is multiplied by player count
